title: Phantom Seer
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Iori Katanagi is a lazy, reluctant shaman who can tame and use 'phantoms' (yokai-like spirits) and would rather be normal. When he meets Riku Aibetsu, a helpful girl who turns out to attract phantoms, he gets a chance to track down Senjudoji, a sadistic phantom who killed someone close to him. The Weekly Shonen Jump series ran four volumes and was cancelled (Wikipedia; MANGA Plus blurb via AniList; MU Axed).
life_message: Even a reluctant person should use his gifts to protect others, and a willing helper can grow strong through training.

folkways.japan: Yokai, a tengu and shaman families draw on Japanese folk religion, and the reluctant-hero setup is a Weekly Shonen Jump convention.

delivery.note: The villain Senjudoji is a monster rather than a worldview (Wikipedia: sadistic, cruel, arrogant), so no view is personified.
